PRE-REGISTERED ACTION TREE (T-75min lineup window, 2026-07-18 ~19:45 UTC, session must be present; magnitudes pre-committed at Fable acceptance, never recomputed ad hoc; market price is never an amend reason): (1) Bellingham suspended by FIFA over the Barco incident before kickoff -> amend +8 France (star class, below the Messi/Yamal 10-class; England's joint-top scorer and primary engine). (2) Mbappe NOT in the France XI -> amend -4 France (removes Factor 2's size cap). (3) Kane NOT in the England XI -> amend +4 France. (4) Rotation-count trigger, baseline = each team's semifinal starting XI, Saliba excluded from France's count: if England's change count >= France's -> amend +6 France (Factor 2's premise reversed); if France's changes minus England's >= 5 -> amend an ADDITIONAL -3 France. (5) GK: uncapped Risser starts for France -> additional -3 France; Dean Henderson starts for England -> +2 France. (6) Anything else (Stones rested, Konsa/O'Reilly in, Doue/Cherki starts, etc.) -> stand (squad-depth noise, already inside Factor 2).

payload.contamination_notes: AUTO-M-LOCK (CHANGELOG 2026-07-08): this lock was produced mechanically from eloratings.net only — the process cannot see an odds source, and no analyst formed a judgment. Instrument J is absent in v1 by design; it must be added pre-market by an odds-clean session (score.py audits the j-bearing version's timestamp against first odds contact). | J added 2026-07-16 by an odds-clean session: analyst has seen NO market price for m103 (odds/ contains no m103 file at amend time -- verified programmatically immediately before this build; the same session settled m101/m102 and read THOSE matches' closing prices, which is per-match-irrelevant to m103). Evidence: base bundle m103_fra_eng_prelock.md passed firewall.py CLEAN before reading; two refresh bundles (FRA/ENG sides) gathered by odds-firewalled subagents -- ENG bundle CLEAN on first validation; FRA bundle FLAGGED on first validation (digit inside a French bookmaker page TITLE within its odds_exposure section, '3e place' adjacent to 'Cotes' -- benign class), returned to the subagent for self-fix WITHOUT the analyst reading it, re-validated CLEAN, only then read. Golden-Boot-adjacent searches surfaced odds-page titles in result listings on both sides; no market number was transcribed anywhere (per odds_exposure sections). DECISION_PROTOCOL section-7 acceptance: performed by Fable 5 in-session (owner switched the session model before the amend; recorded in j.basis).

basis: J deviates from M by NET -3 d_eff toward England (M d=+47 -> J d=+44), the net of THREE decomposed factors (m96 lesson: no undecomposed bundles): rest_travel +3 France, incentive_rotation -4 France, injury_replacement -2 France (Saliba). qualify_home = P(France wins the bronze match incl ET+PK) at pk_h=0.5. First England-ward net deviation in the sample; the direction is computed from the evidence, not engineered.

FACTOR 1, rest_travel +3 (toward France): England has 3 rest days (semi 07-15 Atlanta) vs France's 4 (semi 07-14 Arlington) -- confirmed by Tuchel himself on 07-15: 'We have one less day of recovery than France, but we will do it with professionalism' (Goal.com 07-16). England additionally carried a 120-minute QF (Norway, 07-11 AET) vs France's 90-minute QF two days EARLIER (Morocco, 07-09) -- a heavier cumulative load over the last two rounds. Partial offset folded into the size: France's longer travel leg to Miami (Boston camp ~1,250mi vs Atlanta ~600mi, both arriving J-2). Absorption: maximal -- the asymmetry was stated by the England coach in a televised presser, so only residual is priced. Mechanism-type self-flag: rest_travel ledger n=2, J-better 1/2, mixed (n<5, informational). Conservative +3, deliberately below m104's +5 (which had two extra ETs plus a 39-year-old playing every minute).

FACTOR 2, incentive_rotation -4 (toward England): asymmetric rotation and motivation signals, France-negative. France side: multi-outlet French press consensus (RMC-derived: touteleurope, maxifoot ~07-16) expects HEAVY rotation -- reported playing time for Kante and L. Hernandez (unused all tournament), Gusto, Konate, Zaire-Emery, Cherki; attack 'largement remaniee' with Olise and Dembele named as physically drained; at the 07-15 recovery session only Digne and Rabiot of the Spain starters did outdoor laps; Kante appeared at the M103 presser alongside Deschamps (weak XI signal). Squad-morale signal folded in AT REDUCED WEIGHT (single-source maxifoot, entourage: players 'disgusted at having to play', some planning vacations) -- counted inside this factor, NOT as a standalone. England side: UK media consensus expects a NEAR-FULL XI ('Tuchel should otherwise field a strong XI', Sports Mole 07-16 predicted XI keeps Pickford-Rice-Anderson-Rogers-Bellingham-Gordon-Kane; no Rashford/Toney/Madueke starts predicted anywhere), Tuchel publicly committed to 'professionalism' and stays through Euro 2028. SIZE CAP applied: Mbappe is reported 'tempted' to start chasing the Golden Boot (tied 8 with Messi; FIFA tiebreaker is assists, Messi 4 leads -> Mbappe must OUT-score, and bronze-match goals count; five prior Golden Boots were decided in third-place matches) -- France's highest-leverage attacker likely plays, capping the factor at -4 instead of deeper. Honesty flag: BOTH XIs are preview-grade until T-75; the pre-registered action tree below re-adjusts on the actual team sheets. Mechanism-type: incentive/rotation signals (legal J family); no ledger precedent for a dead-rubber context (first bronze match in the sample) -> novel-context flag, size kept in the smallest class.

FACTOR 3, injury_replacement -2 (toward England): William Saliba is confirmed OUT (multi-source 07-15/16: nbcsports, goal.com, footmercato; back surgery looming, ~4-5 months out; absent from 07-15 training; French media call him 'the only confirmed forfait'). First-choice CB out would normally rate the +/-5 secondary-starter class (m104 tree precedent), but two blunting facts cap it at -2: France's CB depth is strong (Konate/Upamecano/Lacroix -- the predicted XIs slot Konate or Lacroix in without reaching for a makeshift), and in an expected-rotation match the replacement-level gap narrows. Overlap guard: Saliba is EXCLUDED from Factor 2's rotation-change counting (see action tree) so the forced change is not double-priced.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- France morale collapse as a standalone factor: single-source (maxifoot entourage quote), and two-sided against the same camp's counter-signals (Deschamps 07-16 presser: 'on va tout faire pour aller la chercher', duty framing, plus his 185th-and-final match farewell narrative with Mbappe's earlier 'play the best game for him' quote). Folded into Factor 2 at reduced weight instead; declining the standalone is the m96 anti-bundle discipline.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- Deschamps farewell win-incentive as +France: the France-positive mirror of the morale story, resting on narrative quotes only; declining the flattering side of a two-sided story is the two-sidedness check (m101/m104 pattern).

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- Reece James out (+France): strong media consensus but no official confirmation, AND the replacement (Spence) had a standout semifinal and keeps the predicted RB slot regardless -- net impact below the smallest size class.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- third-place-match openness/draw-suppression base rate (approx. 1 draw-in-90 in the 17 editions since 1954, zero since 1990; no sub-2-goal bronze match since 1974; recent-era high-scoring tendency): (i) fully public and heavily cited in previews -> market-priced, feeding it in makes J a market simulator; (ii) the preregistered ordered-logit 1x2 instrument takes only d_eff and admits no draw-specific shape deviation, and the lock schema has no j.lambdas field to carry a tempo multiplier (m104 precedent). Logged for the decision-support layer only.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- semifinal form/process (France 0.30 xG vs Spain, a 60-year low; England 0.53 xG vs Argentina): both processes were poor, roughly symmetric, and both losses are already inside the 07-16 Elo fetch; trading either side is noise.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- Miami heat/thunderstorm (NWS 07-16 point forecast: high 93F, 30-40% storms bracketing the 5pm ET kickoff): affects both sides symmetrically, tempo-axis only, uncodable in schema; logged for the decision layer.

qualify_home uses pk_h=0.5 (the default): neither keeper carries a Dibu-class shootout record -- Pickford's international shootout save record was already characterized in this project's m102 lock as near GK base rate (career 4/14), and no anchored Maignan shootout evidence was found; both GK identities additionally carry rotation uncertainty (Samba's 07-15 calf knock means France's options are Maignan again or an uncapped debutant Risser; Pickford predicted but unconfirmed). No deviation without anchoring.

FABLE ACCEPTANCE (DECISION_PROTOCOL section 7): owner switched the session model to Fable 5 before this amend; the J-basis acceptance was performed by Fable in-session -- all three factor magnitudes and the pk layer approved; one tightening applied: the action tree's rotation-change counting got a crisp baseline (changes counted vs each team's semifinal starting XI; Saliba excluded from France's count to avoid double-pricing Factor 3).
